Shared Rhythm

Gathering space + collective rhythm

Four unequal folded faces hold an open shared space. Their changing heights suggest people responding together in praise.

Refined: The favored main shape is preserved. The name has closer line spacing and a new single-line arrangement.

The architectural reading remains abstract; the complete parish name supplies clear context.

02

Open Praise

Tabernacle + Praise through negative space

A P-like outer contour holds an open T-shaped interior, bringing the two initials into one compact gesture.

Refined: The inner crossbar now meets the stem at one level; the outer silhouette is preserved.

The T is still a reading to test. Color and geometric alignment do not guarantee recognition.

Small changes, with a practical purpose

Preserved comparisons make this refinement pass reviewable.

Open Praise / counter

The baseline and trials remain available. The chosen contour is tested against the former crossbar; the outer P and open lower exit remain intact. T/P recognition still needs audience feedback.

Full-name lettering

Instrument Sans title case remains the working companion. Optical spacing and line leading are adjusted; all words retain equal size and weight. The single-line name is a new practical arrangement.

Actual-size proof supplied

Use the separate A4 vector sheet at 100% / actual size, then check its 50 mm ruler. Physical printing and material performance have not been verified here.

RCCG pairing remains open

The original supplied emblem PNG is still absent. No emblem is recreated and no actual two-logo pairing is claimed.

Team feedback comes later. These drafts record the working direction; they do not establish final identity or production standards.
